0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-4) head into this 12th game of their season at home with a 3-2 home record, sitting 1st in the Southeast and 4th in the East, and riding a four-game win streak after going 6-4 in their last ten. The Los Angeles Lakers (9-2) arrive as the 1st team in the Pacific and the West, on a five-game win streak with an 8-2 record over their last ten. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Los Angeles is without Quentin Grimes (finger) and Austin Reaves is day-to-day with an illness. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, having split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Hawks lost their last meeting 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
